source_text:
Set $\mu=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}a_n\nu_n$ for a suitable sequence
$\sequencen{a_n}$ of strictly positive numbers.   For each $n$ choose a
Radon-Nikod\'ym derivative $f_n$ of $\nu_n$ with respect to $\mu$.
Show that $\{f_n:n\in\Bbb N\}$ is uniformly integrable, so that $\nu$ is
truly continuous.
target_text:
Tetapkan $\mu=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}a_n|\nu_n|$ untuk suatu barisan
$\sequencen{a_n}$ bilangan positif tegas yang sesuai. Untuk
setiap $n$ pilih turunan Radon-Nikod\'ym $f_n$ dari $\nu_n$ terhadap $\mu$.
Tunjukkan bahwa $\{f_n:n\in\Bbb N\}$ terintegralkan secara seragam, sehingga
$\nu$ kontinu sejati.

source_text:
show
that $\sequencen{a_nu_n}$ is uniformly integrable whenever
$\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=0$ in $\Bbb R$ and $\sequencen{u_n}$ is a sequence
in $A$.
target_text:
tunjukkan bahwa
$\sequencen{a_nu_n}$ terintegralkan secara seragam bila
$\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n=0$ dalam $\Bbb R$ dan $\sequencen{u_n}$ suatu barisan
dalam $A$.
